diff:
A check_wav.py
A speak.ps1

--- check_wav.py ---
import wave
w = wave.open('announcement.wav','rb')
print('channels', w.getnchannels(), 'rate', w.getframerate(), 'sampwidth', w.getsampwidth())
print('duration_s', round(w.getnframes()/w.getframerate(), 2))

--- speak.ps1 ---
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Speech
$s = New-Object System.Speech.Synthesis.SpeechSynthesizer
$s.SetOutputToWaveFile("$PSScriptRoot\announcement.wav")
$s.Rate = 0
$s.Speak("Welcome aboard the evening ferry. Please keep your bags clear of the doors.")
$s.Dispose()
(Get-Item "$PSScriptRoot\announcement.wav").Length
